text: Meeting on Free Fire — two countries, one sky. Romania to Pakistan.
The first ping that somehow felt different, quieter and kinder.
From the start it felt like I'd known Himena since before we were born.
White, pizza, art and nature — all the lovely things that are you, Mena.
Staying up way too late talking across timezones — and never wanting to stop.
That inside joke that only the two of us understand.
How your laugh can make my whole day brighter, no matter how far away.
Art — you love it, so I made a hundred little pieces for you.
Bucharest and Pakistan — different skies, same stars.
The same moon we both look up at, on different sides of the world.
You make a place feel like home, just by being you.
The way you care — quietly, genuinely, always.
Every 'goodnight' that leaves me already looking forward to 'good morning'.
Long distance doesn't feel so long when it feels this right.
The stars we share — now on our little starmap, just for us.
You make me want to make things — letters, codes, little corners of joy.
